required "6. State, Local, & Non-U.S. Government Employment A variety of state and local laws restrict the post-government employment (PGE) activities of FORMER state/local government employees. These laws may also place conditions on CURRENT state/local government employees who engage in discussions regarding PGE and may include an obligation to disqualify from continued participation in certain matters that may directly impact the financial interests of a prospective employer.State/local government restrictions vary from state to state but may include contracting, procurement, regulatory or legislative roles, or other public employment within state, city, or municipal government. These restrictions may also extend full- and part-time internships, and teaching or graduate assistantships, at any of these types of public institutions/entities. National Guard service on M-Day status or exclusively under Title 32 status are generally considered to be state government employees.
